bibl.title: A list of village payments and the bouleutic career of Theodoros
bibl.seg: Marcin Kotyl, A list of village payments and the bouleutic career of Theodoros.
bibl.note: Discusses the bouleutic career of a certain Theodoros, son of Komasios, who flourished in fourth-century Hermopolis. Based on an edition of a new papyrus fragment (P.Giss. inv. 307), it argues that Theodoros - before he was the riparius in 362 CE - served as the praepositus pagi. Also, a revision of CPR VIII 36,7 reveals that at a certain point in his career Theodoros was called the prototypos poleos, which is a forerunner of the later proteuon or the honorary titulature for members of the city council.
